packageRules.description: 3d-lab crates share types across one git revision; a partial bump compiles two incompatible copies, so update them as one cohort.
Crates from one git repository must move together; single-crate digest bumps split the graph across revisions.
torch and torchvision are released as a version pair; a single bump leaves the sidecar unresolvable.
PyTorch publishes no cp315 wheels yet (checked 2026-11-21 for torch 2.9.1 and 2.11.0), so the sidecar stays below Python 3.15.
